description: This PHP script deletes an ACL role record in the SuiteCRM system. It initializes an ACL role bean, marks a specified record as deleted if provided, and then redirects the user.

classes.name: ACLRoles
classes.description: A CRM role object representing access control roles in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Marks a specified ACL role record as deleted in the database.
